collection: Fixed GreedyEpisodeRunner policies; first-index choices; every attempted game once; preserve rejections; no replacements, tuning, retraining or checkpoint selection.
evaluation: All admitted rows of each external batch, no split. Group ordered matchup and rounded turn; pair ith win with ith loss in original row order. Strict correct, incorrect and exact ties; half-credit ties secondary. Aggregate by summed counts and per matchup. No independent-observation confidence intervals.
baselines: encoded own HQ defense minus opponent HQ defense
limitations: Offline outcome-associated ranking only; not actual action quality or playing strength.
First four ordered matchups repeat training deck pairs with new seeds; last four are new deck pairs.
